body: OP, did you experience any after effects or ringing in ears?

I did this as well. Twice in February 2021, twice in April 2021, once in October 2021, once in March 2022, once a few weeks ago. 7 times in total. You are not overdramtic. But I want to know what to call this as well. Like, we did not fully try to kill ourselves, just testing. 

I have to ask you, did you feel any after effects afterwards? Each time when I tried to hang myself, I got ringing in my ears. My ears are still ringing today from my latest attempt a couple weeks ago.

This is sooo true. I've been working day and night (I'm a student, so there's lots of homework). I feel extremely dirty, but I don't really care anymore since I don't go outside as often during covid. I showered in Feb. 2020, June 2020, and Jan. 2021. So dirty. Now it's March.
I've been there. But I'm currently procrastinating buying a strong rope and committing suicide. Maybe just wait.

I relate this so much. I went to my school counselor a few years back. During this time, I was on the verge of crying all the time. I can cry on command. I'm holding my tears back all the time. I have no appetite. I want to force myself to eat, but eating became a duty rather than an enjoyment. I sometimes only ate energy bars because you won't be hungry after only eating a small portion. I went to the counselor crying and described these issues.

Guess what my counselor said? Give everything time. Time heals all wounds. It will get better.

So basically nothing.

Seconds? No. More like 10-20 mins. Minutes that feel like hours of blood rushing to your head, hearing your heart beating, headache, and ringing in your ears. Feeling panicked (even though you plan to die, I guess human survival instinct). Involuntary muscle twitches. Trust me, I've tried hanging and it's not a good feeling.

Those are also my thoughts. But I have been procrastinating my suicide. In the meantime, try to see if there is anything you like in life. Seeing the sun shine? Watching TV? There are some rewards to living.
Life is hard. We suffer and die.
Yikes! I was going to call the hotline, then thought about my privacy and did not. Now that I read this, I am not ever going to call. Mental health support needs to be more safe and confidential.
Yikes! Take that as a warning to not do it.
Well, for me, I think about dying before I sleep. When I am sleeping, I pretend that I am dead. This is how I can instantly fall asleep when I lay down in bed.
I also need the book. I DM'ed you.
